% Pattern: head/proof. A proof head after a comment and \normalfont, inside
% the environment of the statement, starts the proof. Seen in the gold pilot
% (set X).
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1
% want head-1 proof - proves=lem-1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{lem}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{lem} Every compact space is bounded.

%
\normalfont {\bf Proof.} Cover the space by finitely many balls.
\end{lem}
\end{document}
